title: Metrics: precision, recall, faithfulness and relevance

videos.script: Precision and recall mean the same arithmetic about two different things: what a search returned, and what a detector flagged. {{two}} Take the judge from the last lesson as a detector of irrelevant replies, and move its threshold. {{sweep}} At the lab's setting it flags nothing. Higher, it catches all seven bad replies, and six good ones with them. Higher still, only false alarms. {{trade}} Which threshold is right depends on what the flag drives. An alert wants precision. A release gate wants recall. {{which}} Then five metrics for the two releases. Faithfulness and relevance sit at one, on both. A metric that cannot fall says nothing. {{flat}} Context precision rises, context recall falls. The release's floor is a threshold too, and it bought precision with recall. {{floor}} And a name is not a definition. Each framework means something different by relevance. {{names}}
